about: Inkling 2 Mini (26B looped MoE, ~3B active, vision, thinking) UD-Q4_K_XL with the F16 vision projector on one 24 GB card, everything on the GPU, no draft model. Without the DSpark draft the full 131,072-token window fits with f16 KV, the default ubatch and CUDA graphs on: the server takes 22,945 MiB at ready, and on an RTX 3090 that was also driving a desktop (733 MiB) the whole card peaked at 23,910 of 24,576 MiB over three repeat gate runs. llama.cpp from Unsloth's prebuilt b12588-mix-c0c3de8 (unslothai/llama.cpp 8832860, CUDA 13 portable): the Inkling 2 architecture is not in a ggml-org release yet. One slot, flash attention at its default, Thinking Machines' recommended sampling. Measured under WSL2 (Ubuntu 24.04 on Windows 11), not bare-metal Linux. On that machine the same launch with GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 decodes at 19.8 tok/s instead of 52, and with -ub 128 the lab's prefill is 638 tok/s instead of about 1,030.
setup: Not Docker; Linux x86-64 with an NVIDIA driver for CUDA 13. Unpack the archive into llama-b12588-mix-c0c3de8/ next to models/ and run from that directory. The archive does not bundle the CUDA runtime: put libcudart.so.13, libcublas.so.13 and libcublasLt.so.13 (PyPI nvidia-cuda-runtime 13.3.29 and nvidia-cublas 13.5.1.27) in cuda13-runtime/ and install libgomp1, or the server fails to load its CUDA backend.
